product_summary: PI Cottex Pvt Ltd, Focal Point, Dhandari Kalan, Ludhiana (Punjab) — vertically integrated knitted fabric manufacturer and process house, established 2007, ~200,000 sq ft unit, ~15 t/day. Real product range per own website (picottex.com, homepage + /about/): 100% cotton, polyester/cotton (PC) blends, cotton blended with lycra/spandex, 100% polyester, 100% viscose, 100% modal, slub jersey, pontal/pointelle, 3-thread brushed/non-brushed fleece, 2-thread terry brushed/non-brushed, in knit structures single jersey/lycra, double jersey/lycra, rib, interlock/lycra, pique/lycra, mini jacquard/lycra; supplied in solids and prints. Also offers job-work services: knitting, dyeing, printing, finishing (brushing). Certifications claimed: GOTS, GRS, OEKO-TEX. Sister concern: Pruthi Exports (garments).
role_hint: manufacturer (own knitting + in-house dyeing/printing/finishing process house; no trader signs found on site — no third-party sourcing or resale language). Note: also acts as a commission/job-work processor for third-party greige fabric, which is a service line, not a trading line.
comment: INDUSTRY MISCLASSIFICATION: declared industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food & FMCG) is wrong — the company is a knitted-fabric textile manufacturer (Ch. 60). Correct industry: textiles / knitted fabrics. HS mapping: declared 6001.92 (pile/terry/fleece, man-made) is CORROBORATED — site explicitly lists 3-thread brushed/non-brushed fleece and 2-thread terry brushed/non-brushed, plus 100% polyester. Declared 6004.10 (elastomeric >=5%) is CORROBORATED — site lists cotton-lycra, poly-lycra, pique-lycra, S/J lycra, rib lycra, interlock lycra, mini jacquard lycra. Declared 6006.22 (other knitted cotton, dyed) is CORROBORATED — site lists dyed cotton single jersey, pique, rib, interlock, and an in-house dyeing house. So all three declared codes are plausible and consistent with the real product mix — status 'partial' rather than 'exact' only because the declaration is INCOMPLETE, not wrong. MISSING FROM DECLARATION: (a) 6004.90 — non-cotton elastomeric knits (viscose-lycra, modal-lycra) which the site explicitly lists; (b) 6006.23 — dyed knits of synthetic fibres (100% polyester, PC blends) — the site lists 100% polyester and PC, but only 6006.22 (cotton) is declared; (c) 6006.42 / 6006.43 — PRINTED knitted fabrics, a stated core line ('solids & prints', in-house printing division) with no printed-fabric code declared at all; (d) 6006.32 — yarns of different colours (mini jacquard / slub jersey are typically of yarns of different colours, not plain dyed). Also note the company sells PROCESSING SERVICES (dyeing/printing/finishing job work) which fall outside Ch. 60 goods codes entirely. Per project rule 3, the HS gaps are NOT grounds for rejection — company is retained and codes corrected/expanded as above. EVIDENCE LIMIT: all product facts above come from the company's own website (picottex.com homepage and /about/), i.e. self-declaration. No customs line, shipping bill, B/L or GST turnover record was checked in this task (out of scope per role), therefore the actual export/domestic shipment of these specific HS lines is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. The site does claim 'both the domestic and export markets' and 'catering to the international market', but no dated shipment record was verified — treat as declared, not confirmed. IndiaMART page could not be read (HTTP 429), so no third-party catalogue corroboration. No CIN/PAN/GSTIN verified in this task — null.
